## About
Nepa Auto Repair is a neighborhood shop on W Shady Grove Rd in Grand Prairie. We work on most foreign and domestic vehicles, from a simple oil change to a full engine replacement or an electrical problem that's been driving you crazy.
Our technicians use the latest diagnostics equipment, and we explain everything we do to your car in plain terms. Neighbors have given us a 4.5 rating across 278 Google reviews, and many of them mention honest work at a fair price.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repair after minor or major accidents, including dent removal, frame straightening and paintwork.
- Engine services and repairs: Inspections, filters, fuel pump and ignition wire work to keep your engine healthy.
- Brake services and repairs: Care for the whole braking system, including pads, fluid and rotors.
- Transmission service: Fluid flush and replacement, filter service and a new pan gasket.
- Electrical diagnosis and repairs: We track down electrical problems and fix them.
- Air conditioning service and repairs
- Tire sales, mounting and balancing
- Steering and suspension service
- Pre-purchase vehicle evaluation: Have us look over a car before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: Most foreign and domestic vehicles, including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Lexus, Chevy and Ford.

Q: Do you work with insurance on collision repairs?
A: Yes. We work with all major insurance providers on collision work, from the first estimate to final delivery.

Q: Can I get a loaner car?
A: We may be able to provide a loaner car for the day. Please call ahead to check.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: On W Shady Grove Rd in Grand Prairie, by HWY 161.
